Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-3000 K: $Cp^{0} = 13.561 + 0.170 \times 10^{-3} T - 1.883 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0}-H_{298}^{0} = 13.561 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.085 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 1.883 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 4.682$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-2000 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -12.358 + 1.046 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.395 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 85.850 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -12.358 - 1.046 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.395 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 42.925 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 23.740 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 2000-3000 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -9.283 - 0.704 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.065 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 1701.700 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -9.283 + 0.704 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.065 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 850.850 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 9.781 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Pankratz (91).
